{
  "name": "subway-narrator",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "description": "Subway Surfers-style runner pane that reads Claude's replies aloud with OpenAI text-to-speech while a turn runs",
  "author": {
    "name": "Kaiyu Hsu"
  },
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "openaiApiKey": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "OpenAI API key",
      "description": "Used for narration. Empty: falls back to the OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable, then the system voice.",
      "sensitive": true,
      "default": ""
    },
    "voice": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Narrator voice",
      "description": "OpenAI voice for the narration",
      "options": [
        "ash",
        "alloy",
        "ballad",
        "coral",
        "echo",
        "fable",
        "nova",
        "onyx",
        "sage",
        "shimmer",
        "verse"
      ],
      "default": "ash"
    },
    "model": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Speech model",
      "description": "OpenAI speech model; only gpt-4o-mini-tts follows the narrator style",
      "options": [
        "gpt-4o-mini-tts",
        "tts-1",
        "tts-1-hd"
      ],
      "default": "gpt-4o-mini-tts"
    }
  }
}
